results.title: Katsina ta sanyawa Sarakuna dokar karɓar bakuncin Turawa ƴan yawon buɗe Ido
results.content: Gwamnatin jihar Katsina ta fitar da jerin sabbin dokoki da ya zama dole masu riƙe da sarautun gargajiya su yi biyayya garesu, matakin da ke zuwa bayan dambarwar da ta biyo baya tsakanin Mai Martaba Sarkin Daura Alhaji Faruk Umar Faruk da wata baturiya ƴar yawon buɗe idanu wadda ta yi zargin Sarkin yayi yunƙurin haike mata lokacin da ta kai ziyara fadar.

results.title: Kurdawa na samun nasara a kan mayakan ISIS a Syria
results.content: Dubban yan gudun hijira na ci gaba da tserewa fadan da ake tabkawa tsakanin Kurdawa da mayakan Jihadin kungiyar Isis a kasar Syriya al'amarin da ya haifar da kwararar 'yan gudun hijira a kasar Turkiya.

results.title: An samu raguwar kona motoci a bikin sabuwar shekara a Faransa
results.content: Gwamnatin Faransa tace an samu raguwar yawan adadin motocin da ake konewa a lokacin bikin sabuwar shekara da kashi 12 cikin 100 a cikin kasar. alkalumma sun nuna cewa a jajibirin sabuwar shekara an kone motoci 940 sabanin 1,067, da aka cinna wa wuta a shekarar da ta gabata.

results.title: Nijar ta tabbatar da mutuwar sojinta 11 a wani hari da ƴan ta'adda suka kai musu
results.content: Ma’aikatar kula da harkokin tsaron Nijar ta ce mayaƙan Boko Haram sun kashe sojojin ƙasar 11 sannan wasu 5 suka samu raunuka, a wani hari da suka kai musu lokacin da suke gudanar da sintiri a garin Baroua da ke jihar Diffa a shiyar kudu maso gabashin ƙasar.

results.title: Kotun Duniya ta bukaci Afirka ta Kudu ta cafke El-Bashir
results.content: Kotun hukunta manyan laifufuka a duniya ICC ko kuma CPI ta bukaci hukumomin kasar Afirka ta kudu da su kama shugaban Sudan Umar Hasan El-bashir wanda ke halarar taron shugabannin Afirka yanzu haka a birnin Johannesburg.

results.title: An cafke mutane da dama kan zargin juyin mulki a Gambia
results.content: An cafke mutane da dama, da ake zargi suna da hannu a yunkurin jurin juyin mulkin da aka yi a kasar Gambia, lokacin da shugaban kasa Yahya Jammeh ke ziyara a birnin Dubai, wanda kuma ya dora alhakin harin kan ‘yan kasashen waje da bai bayyana sunayen su ba.

results.title: Ana samun mutane 64,000 da ke kamuwa da cutar Sida kowacce shekara a Najeriya
results.content: Har yanzu Najeriya na samun mutane aƙalla dubu 64,000 masu kamuwa da cuta mai karya garkuwar jiki wato HIV, kowacce shekara sama da mutane 5,000 da hukumomi suka ce bai kamata su ɗara haka ba matuƙar ana son kawo ƙarshen cutar.

results.title: Ambaliyar Ruwan sama ta yi sanadiyar mutuwar mutane 12 a Jojiya
results.content: yanzu haka dai masu kula da namun daji na ci gaba da farautar namun daji a tsakkiyar birnin Tbilissi na kasar Jojiya, bayan da ambaliyar Ruwan sama da aka sheka a birnin ta rusa gidan namun dajin da a halin yanzu suka fantsama a cikin gari

results.title: Ana ci gaba da aikin neman tarkacen jirgin AirAsia
results.content: Yau Juma’a masu aiki neman sassan jirgin saman da ya yi hadari a kan tekun Java na kasar Indonesia, sun ci gaba da aikin, kuma suna gab da kaiwa inda lamarin ya faru. An dakatar da aikin neman Jirgin ne saboda matsalar Yanayi a tekun Indonesia

results.title: Gwamnati ta kafa kwamitin binciken Sarkin Daura
results.content: Gwamnatin jihar Katsina ta arewacin Najeriya ta sanar da kafa wani kwamiti na musamman da zai gudanar da bincike kan wani fai-fan bidiyo da ke yawo a shafukan sada zumunta, wanda ya nuna Sarkin Daura Alhaji Umar Farouk Umar CON yana ƙoƙarin haikewa wata baturiya ƴar yawon buɗe idanu.

results.title: Taron Kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25
results.content: A yau lahadi ake buda taron shugabannin kasashen kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25 a birnin Jonnesburg na kasar Afirka ta Kudu, taron da zai mayar da hankali kan batutuwa da dama da suka shafi kasashen nahiyar.

results.title: Jami’an Italiya sun yi kokarin ceto jirgin ruwan Bakin haure
results.content: Jami’an kula da jiragen ruwa a kasar Italiya sun nasarar ceto wani jirgin ruwa da ya samu matsala a tsakiyar teku shake da bakin haure kimanin 450 bayan sun yi nasarar ceto rayuwan bakin haure da dama a cikin kwanaki biyu da suka gabata.

results.title: Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya ta yi gargaɗin kan yiwuwar sake ta’azzarar cutar HIV
results.content: Majalisar ɗinkin duniya ta yi gargaɗin kan yiwuwar sake ta’azzarar cutar HIV a baɗi bayan gagarumar nasarar da aka samu wajen taƙaita yaɗuwarta a shekarun baya-bayan nan mafi ƙololuwa ta aka taɓa gani a tarihi.

results.title: Kotu ba ta amince da tsige shugaba Rajoanarimampianina ba
results.content: Kotun kolin kasar Madagascar ta yi watsi da matakin tsige shugaban kasar Hery Rajoana-rimampianina da majalisar dokokin kasar ta yi a ranar 26 ga watan jiya.

results.title: An sake zabar Netanyahu a matsayin shugaban Jam’iyya mai mulki
results.content: An sake zabar Fraiministan kasar Isra’ila Benjamin Netanyahu, a matsayin shugaban jam’iyyar Likud mai mulkin kasar, a wani zaben fitar da gwanin da aka yi jiya Alhamis. Zaben na zuwa ne a daidai lokacin da ake shirin yin wani zaben gaggawa a kasar, inda ya kayar da abokin takarar shi Danny Danon mai ra’ayin gurguzu.

results.title: APC ce ke haddasa rikice-rikicen siyasa a Najeriya- Rabi'u Musa Kwankwaso
results.content: Tsohon Gwamnan Kano kuma ɗan takarar mataimakin shugaban ƙasar jam'iyyar NDC, Rabi'u Musa Kwankwaso ya zargi jam'iyyar APC mai mulki da haifar da tashe tashen hankulan da ke gani.

results.title: Sarkozy ya soki kawance da ke fada da mayakan IS
results.content: Tsohon shugaban Faransa Nicolas Sarkozy ya yi kakkausar ga kawancen dakarun kasashen duniya a karkashin jagorancin Amurka, dangane da yadda ya kasa murkushe mayakan da ke da’awar jihadi a kasashen Syria da Iraki.

results.title: Chadi ta yi Allah wadai da matakin Nijar na korar ƴan ƙabilar Mahamid daga ƙasar
results.content: Gwamnatin Chadi ta yi Allah wadai da matakin Nijar na korar dubban makiyaya Larabawa ƴan ƙabilar ƴan ƙabilar Mahamid, tana bayyana hakan a matsayin wanda ya saɓa wa dokokin ƙasa da ƙasa.

results.title: Hillary na gudanar da yakin neman zaben shugabancin Amurka
results.content: Tsohuwar sakatariyar harkokin wajen Amurka Hillary Clinton ta kaddamar da yakin neman zabenta na neman tsayawa takarar shugabancin Amurka a jiya asabar, inda ta ce tana fatar kasancewar mace ta farko da za ta jagoranci kasar a tarihi.

results.title: Ƙawancen Gavi na shirin sayen allurar gwaji ta rigakafin cutar Ebola
results.content: Ƙawancen ƙungiyoyin da ke tattara tallafi don samar da alluran rigakafin yaƙi da wasu cututtuka a duniya da ake kira Gavi, ya sanar da shirin sayen sabuwar allurar gwaji kan nau'in ƙwayar cutar Ebola har miliyan ɗaya da rabi na sabuwar allurar gwaji kan nau'in ƙwayar cutar Ebola mai saurin yaɗuwa da ke kuma haifar da ɓarkewar cutar, matuƙar aka tabbatar da inganci da kuma tasirinta.

results.title: RFI Hausa zai sauya Shafinsa na Intanet
results.content: Daga 15 ga watan Yuni, hausa.rfi.fr, shafin Intanet na RFI Hausa zai sauya sabuwar fuska, mai bayar da muhimmanci kan salon yada labarai irin na rediyo da hotunan bidiyo.

results.title: Amnesty ta buƙaci gaggauta sakin Rokiatou Doumbia da aka tsare a Mali
results.content: Ana saran dubban mutane daga sassan duniya su shiga wani gangami da za’a gudanar domin goyan bayan Rokiatou Doumbia, wata fitacciyar ƴar kasuwa kuma wadda ta yi fice a kafar TikTok sakamakon tsare ta da hukumomin Mali suka yi ba bisa ƙa’ida ba.

results.title: Ana samun ƙaruwar garkuwa da mutane a kewayen tafkin Chadi-Rahoto
results.content: Yayin da hare-haren ƙungiyoyin masu iƙirarin jihadi ke ci gaba da addabar ƙasashen yankin Tafkin Chadi, rahotanni daga ƙasar Kamaru na cewa an samu ƙaruwar sace-sacen fararen hula domin neman kuɗin fansa a yankin arewacin ƙasar.

results.title: Amurka na shirin korar wasu ƴan Najeriya 157 sakamakon aikata laifuka
results.content: Amurka ta sanar da jerin sunayen wasu mutane 157 ƴan asalin Najeriya da aka kama tare da shirin mayar da su ƙasarsu ta asali sakamakon aikata laifuka, da kuma take dokokin ƙasa.

results.title: Wani sabon salon Damfara da ya ɓulla a arewacin Najeriya
results.content: Bayanai na nuni da yadda ake ƙara samun al'umma musamman a arewacin Najeriya, da ke faɗawa tarkon ƴan damfara da ke bayyana kan su a matsayin wakilan Bankunan tafi da gidan ka kamar Kuda da Opay da Moniepoint da kuma Palmpay, inda su ke karɓar lambar BVN da NIN domin buɗewa jama'a asusun ajiya kyauta tare da basu wani tagomashi.

results.title: Kotun wasanni ta duniya ta tabbatar da Senegal a matsayin wacce ta lashe kofin AFCON
results.content: Kotun sauraron ƙararrakin wasanni ta Duniya ta maida wa Senegal kofin gasar ƙasashen Afrika ta AFCON ta shekarar 2025 da hukumar CAF ta ƙwace daga hannunta ta kuma miƙa wa Morocco.

results.title: Kungiyar Yari Sports Initiative zata fara aikin zaƙulo haziƙan ƴan wasa daga arewacin Najeriya
results.content: Ƙungiyar Yari Sports Initiative (YSI) ta ƙaddamar da shirin zaƙulo ƙwararrun ƴan wasa matasa a faɗin jihohin Arewa 19 da Babban Birnin Tarayya Abuja, domin ba su damar nuna bajintarsu a wasannin ƙwallon ƙafa, dambe da tseren dawaki.

results.title: Shugabar FA ta shiga yarjejeniyar sirri domin karanta takardun cinikin FIFA
results.content: Shugabar hukumar ƙwallon ƙafa ta Ingila (FA), Debbie Hewitt, ta rattaba hannu kan yarjejeniyar kare sirri (NDA) a matsayin sharaɗin samun damar duba takardun da suka shafi shirin shugaban FIFA, Gianni Infantino, na sayar da hannun jari a gasar cin kofin duniya, wanda daga baya aka dakatar.

results.title: Kotu ta yankewa tsohon shugaban ƴan sanan Benin Janar Louis hukuncin shekaru 2 a gidan yari
results.content: Wata kotu ta musamman mai yaƙi da laifukan tattalin arziƙi da ta’addanci a ƙasar Benin ta yanke wa tsohon shugaban rundunar ƴansandan ƙasar, Janar Louis Philippe Houndegon, hukuncin zaman gidan yari na shekara biyu bisa kama shi da laifin cin zarafi ta kafafen sadarwa da kuma tunzura jama’a yin bore.

results.title: Shirin Rayuwata: Ranar yaƙi da cin zarafin ƙananan yara
results.content: Duka, azabtarwa, bautarwa, tare da neman yin lalata da yara na daga cikin manyan matsalolin cin zarafi da kusan kullum ake fadakarwa a kai, dalilin da ya sanya majalisar dinkin duniya ware ranar 18 ga watan nuwamban kowacce shekara a matsayin ranar yaki da cin zarafin yara, tare da tallafawa wadanda suka taba fuskantar matsalar ta kowanne yanayi, musamman fyade.
